name: Upper building pad 1 (about 256 m)
notes: Level 16 × 16 m pad at about 256 m needs roughly 32 m³ of cut and fill (up to 0.7 m deep). About 9.5 h of winter sun (terrain only), west-facing. Mid-slope: sheltered, with moderate cold-air risk. One of the two upper building sites Brett and Blake are working out access to (23 Oct). Computed pad site: check on site.
